answer: Each challenge is derived from a future drand quicknet pulse, whose threshold-BLS signature makes the seed publicly verifiable and unpredictable before publication. Agents commit before the pulse and reveal responses afterward, so automated swarms cannot precompute valid work or farm a reusable cache offline. Fresh seeds, combined with per-identity quotas or economic costs, make mass Sybil participation harder; saffron, violet, and comet can serve as domain-separated labels, not secret entropy.
